title: Software Developer
description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications and systems using programming languages and development tools.
tasks: Write and test clean, efficient code
Collaborate with teams using agile methods
Deploy and maintain applications in production

title: Data Scientist
description: Analyses complex datasets using statistical methods, machine learning and programming to extract business insights and drive decisions.
tasks: Build and train machine learning models

title: ICT Security Specialist
description: Protects computer systems, networks and data from cyber threats, attacks and unauthorised access.
tasks: Conduct penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
Train staff on security best practices

title: Civil Engineer
description: Plans, designs and oversees construction and maintenance of infrastructure such as roads, bridges, dams and buildings.
tasks: Prepare cost estimates and project reports

title: Electrical Engineer
description: Designs, develops and maintains electrical systems and equipment for residential, commercial and industrial use.

title: Professional Nurse
description: Provides comprehensive nursing care to patients in hospitals, clinics and community health settings.
tasks: Assess patient health needs and vital signs
Educate patients and families on health management
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC)

title: General Medical Practitioner
description: Diagnoses and treats a wide range of medical conditions, providing primary healthcare to patients of all ages.
tasks: Refer patients to specialists when needed
learning_pathways: Registration with Health Professions Council of SA (HPCSA)

title: Accountant (General)
description: Plans and provides accounting services including financial reporting, auditing, tax compliance and budget management.

title: Electrician
description: Installs, maintains and repairs electrical wiring, equipment and systems in residential, commercial and industrial settings.
tasks: Ensure compliance with electrical safety codes

title: Plumber
description: Installs, repairs and maintains piping systems for water, gas and waste in buildings and industrial facilities.
tasks: Install and repair water and waste pipe systems
Test pipes for leaks and pressure
Install fixtures such as taps and geysers
learning_pathways: Registration with Institute of Plumbing SA (IOPSA)

title: Bricklayer
description: Lays bricks, concrete blocks and other materials to construct walls, partitions, arches and other structures.
tasks: Lay bricks and blocks to specifications
Ensure structures are level and plumb

title: Automotive Motor Mechanic
description: Diagnoses, repairs and maintains petrol and diesel engines and mechanical systems in motor vehicles.
learning_pathways: N1-N3 Motor Mechanics at TVET College

title: Psychologist
description: Assesses and treats mental, emotional and behavioural disorders using therapeutic techniques and psychological testing.
tasks: Collaborate with medical and social work teams

title: Social Worker
description: Helps individuals, families and communities address social problems and improve their wellbeing and quality of life.
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP)

title: Secondary School Teacher
description: Educates learners in grades 8-12 in specific subject areas, preparing them for the National Senior Certificate (matric).
tasks: Set and mark assessments and exams
Monitor learner progress and provide feedback
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Council for Educators (SACE)

title: Environmental Scientist
description: Studies the environment and assesses the impact of human activities, providing recommendations for environmental protection and sustainability.
tasks: Advise government and industry on compliance
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP)

title: Finance Manager
description: Oversees the financial health of an organisation, managing budgets, financial reporting, and strategic financial planning.

title: Pharmacist
description: Prepares and dispenses medications, advises patients and healthcare providers on safe and effective drug use.
tasks: Counsel patients on medication use and side effects
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC)

title: Architect
description: Designs buildings and structures, balancing aesthetic appeal, functionality, safety and sustainability.
tasks: Oversee construction to ensure design compliance
learning_pathways: Registration with South African Council for the Architectural Profession (SACAP)

title: Lawyer
description: Provides legal advice and representation to individuals, businesses and organisations in civil and criminal matters.
tasks: Advise clients on their legal rights
